metadata.description: Forge: a token-efficient plan-approve-build workflow for Claude Code, with a live dashboard.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Map, enhance, plan, approve, build with parallel subagents, test, hand off. Ponytail discipline, token accounting, live gamified dashboard. Works in any project.

plugins.name: repo-orchestrator
plugins.description: Repository-aware engineering orchestrator: researches the repo, plans only the work needed, implements with file ownership, then tests once at the end and remediates by root cause.

plugins.name: frontend-engineer
plugins.description: Frontend engineering orchestrator: classifies the task, analyses the design reference, implements in parallel with file ownership, tests, checks the rendered page against the reference, and reports evidence-based status.

plugins.name: backend-engineer
plugins.description: Backend engineering orchestrator: reconstructs user journeys from the frontend and requirements, finds gaps early, designs contracts and data, implements and integrates the backend with parallel agents in dependency waves, and verifies complete workflows with evidence.

plugins.name: e2e-engineer
plugins.description: End-to-end test engineering: discovers the app and its user journeys, plans them behind an approval gate, verifies them through web, mobile web, native Android and iOS, cross-layer UI-to-API-to-database checks, the API and the database, then triages defects, hands them to their owners, retests each fix, and reports an evidence-based release status.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Read-only security audit: maps the attack surface, runs specialist reviewers for secrets, dependencies, access control, input handling and configuration, and reports only findings with a reachable path. Never edits source.
